currentSummary: M14.7 qualifies original 7-Zip and Notepad++ x64 MSI installation, removal, reinstallation and guided recovery within the tested bounded profiles. Required original WiX copy/delete bodies execute natively. Notepad++ editor use, Sumatra installation/interface, full original GUI archive tasks and Firefox execution remain unqualified. All original-app tasks remain mandatory in M14.12; whole-system CPU/RAM/storage optimization blocks final M14.15. Native/source/media qualification passes with 98 native and 39 supporting host groups across 138 campaign tasks. Public download and website verification are separate and are being completed; reported advanced BrixCanvas search/navigation remains unqualified and nonblocking. Browser choices can download the original Firefox installer; Firefox installation and execution are not supported yet. The retained private Windows processes run without an embedded Windows guest. Follow M14.0-M14.15, including mandatory whole-system optimization in M14.15.
currentImageAlt: Actual Engacer OS M14.7: review of the original Notepad++ x64 MSI. Package installation is qualified; the editor remains unqualified.
reportedPlatformLimit: BrixCanvas currently omits the saved same-page search and article navigation. Browse the task guides and archive; this reported platform limitation does not block OS milestones.
